summary: Mbandaka, capital of Equateur province, is far from the eastern conflict zones and has no armed group holding territory. Day-to-day order in the city's communes (Mbandaka, Wangata) and neighbourhoods is kept by the Congolese National Police (PNC, including GMI/LENI units), with FARDC (Bokala military camp) and Republican Guard elements garrisoned in the city. Reported incidents in 2025-2026 are police abuses (extortion of moto-taxi drivers, a killing at the central market in Nov 2025) and a May 2026 firefight between Republican Guard and police elements, not challenges to state control. Rural villages of the Bolenge and Mbandaka/Wangata secteurs along the Congo and Ruki rivers have no reported armed-group activity and are assessed as default state (PNC) presence.

zones.description: Mbandaka city (communes of Mbandaka and Wangata, all health-area neighbourhoods) and adjoining peri-urban localities (Libaya, Kinshasa, Inganda, Bolenge Pêcheur)
zones.evidence: Provincial capital with no armed-group presence; PNC (incl. GMI) polices the city and handles arrests, with a 2025 military trial of a police officer for a market killing showing state justice functioning. FARDC (Bokala camp) and Republican Guard are garrisoned; a May 2026 GR-police shootout was an intra-state incident.

zones.description: Rural villages of Bolenge secteur (Wendji, Bongonde, Ikengo, Libinza, etc.) and Mbandaka secteur (Bamanya, Ilelenge, Lolifa, Boyeka, Monzambi Ibonga)
zones.evidence: No reports of armed-group activity in Mbandaka territory's rural secteurs; state presence via police posts and secteur administration, with customary chiefs settling local disputes.
